mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 50 degrees with clear skies at Verona Area High School and an air quality index of 53. The moon is in its third quarter, and if you are up early, the International Space Station will be visible rising over Middleton near the high school and traveling toward Fitchburg while halfway up the sky.

City residents are reminded that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles weekly refuse and biweekly recycling. Also, please note the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.
We have plenty to look forward to, including live music at Bailey's Run today and yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In our weekly report, officers handled a call on October 25 where a man was arrested for O W I after being found at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
